sources.freshness_role: official launch states FTMO Futures is live in beta, with Growth and Pro paths; formal futures rules provide the current 50K Pro daily-loss and drawdown mechanics
independent September 5 analysis verifies the new beta remains an active rule-comparison and calculation topic and flags why official rule wording, not marketing shorthand, must anchor the arithmetic
public September 8 discussion supplies a current futures-versus-forex discovery signal only; it is not used to validate FTMO terms, quality, price or a trading outcome

decision.reopen_trigger: Any dated FTMO Futures rule, payout, plan, availability or platform correction; otherwise retire the beta-launch framing after the current public launch/discovery window and do not turn it into evergreen firm promotion.
decision.rationale: This is a new, dated product category absent from the historical package inventory. The official launch and rulebook establish the beta and 50K Pro daily-loss mechanic; independent September 5 review and September 8 public discussion establish a current verification/discovery path. The content answers only how to reserve a buffer under a stated daily-loss rule and translate the remainder into planned per-trade price risk. It does not recommend the program, compare firms, forecast futures, or claim a contract point value.
